_notes.voice_models: alloy/nova/onyx are OpenAI TTS code names repurposed here as synth-style tags for a generative audio pipeline

assets.name: dubstep-pressure-bed
assets.prompt: Procedural dubstep reference loop 142 BPM: hard sidechain kick, wobble bass with filter sweep, clipped LFO hats, bass sub drop every 8 bars, arena battle tension, clean rhythmic readability for a Flash rhythm game prototype
assets.style: hard dubstep, electronic, 142 BPM, sidechain heavy

assets.name: encounter-intro-prism-bloom
assets.prompt: Encounter intro sting for Prism Bloom: a rising three-note spectral chord that fans outward like a prism splitting light, warm golden tone base, high shimmer treble, resolves on a punchy kick hit

assets.name: encounter-intro-glue-stall
assets.prompt: Encounter intro sting for Glue Stall: a slow warped bassy wobble that bends down and sticks, viscous low-mid smear, slightly off-rhythm to imply stickiness, resolves with a dull thud
assets.style: electronic sting, bass wobble, viscous, 0.9 seconds

assets.name: encounter-intro-spectrum-mote
assets.prompt: Encounter intro sting for Spectrum Mote: three orbiting chime tones rotating in a trefoil pattern, molten amber-pink midrange with pale violet overtone, sinuous tail fade

assets.name: encounter-intro-ember-roll
assets.prompt: Encounter intro sting for Ember Roll: a sharp metallic scythe slash followed by a crisp ring decay, icy high transient then warm-crimson resonance ring, short and aggressive
assets.style: electronic sting, metallic slash, ring, 0.6 seconds

assets.name: encounter-intro-luster-knot
assets.prompt: Encounter intro sting for Luster Knot: a dense cluster chord in deep violet harmonics with five satellite tones spiraling outward, heavy bass fundamental, golden upper radiance, imposing final boss energy

assets.name: lane-hit-head-flick
assets.prompt: Short rhythmic hit sound for catching a Head Flick cue: a bright upward snap with cobalt overtone, like a sharp finger click followed by a tiny spectral ping

assets.name: lane-hit-torso-pulse
assets.prompt: Short rhythmic hit sound for catching a Torso Pulse cue: a deep body thud with a harmonic spectral shockwave ring expanding outward, punchy and satisfying

assets.name: lane-hit-hand-halo
assets.prompt: Short rhythmic hit sound for catching a Hand Halo cue: a spinning ring tone shimmer that resolves into a clean bell stop, ethereal and round

assets.name: lane-hit-foot-spark
assets.prompt: Short rhythmic hit sound for catching a Foot Spark cue: an electric ground-strike zap with a four-point starburst crackle and a sharp yellow-white transient

assets.name: lane-miss-buzz
assets.prompt: Short miss-buzz for a missed rhythm cue: a blunt descending tone that cuts off early, slightly dissonant, flash of cold blue static

assets.name: pose-lock-stinger-success
assets.prompt: Pose-lock success finisher: a bright spectral collapse — sustained golden tone rises then shatters into a shower of ascending chime sparkle, satisfying rhythm-game win sting
assets.style: finisher sting, bright, spectral collapse, 1.4 seconds

assets.name: pose-lock-stinger-fail
assets.prompt: Pose-lock failure stinger: tail backlash recoil sound — a harsh descending wobble that bends away rapidly, cold and punishing, slight reverse-reverb tail
assets.style: failure sting, descending wobble, punishing, 0.9 seconds

assets.name: outfit-tier-unlock-1
assets.prompt: Outfit tier 1 unlock sound — Pulse Sash equip: a quick ascending shimmer with a sash-crack transient at the top, light and bright

assets.name: outfit-tier-unlock-2
assets.prompt: Outfit tier 2 unlock sound — Prism Skirt equip: a prismatic chord fan across three spectral tones, slightly longer shimmer, the skirt fabric sparkle crackling

assets.name: outfit-tier-unlock-3
assets.prompt: Outfit tier 3 unlock sound — Halo Rig equip: a resonant ring tone sustaining for a beat, cable-tension snap accent, warm and weighty

assets.name: outfit-tier-unlock-4
assets.prompt: Outfit tier 4 unlock sound — Light Envisioned transformation: a full epic rise with a spectral crown burst at the peak, five satellite tones circling, golden radiance sustain — the most impressive power-up in the game

assets.name: litemite-warning-hiss
assets.prompt: LiteMite spawn warning hiss: sentient light motes condensing in the visible spectrum, static pressure building with a high emberence crackle and then a short sharp pop as the enemy materialises

assets.name: litemite-defeat-explosion
assets.prompt: LiteMite defeat explosion: a warm expanding ring of sound that shatters outward in all directions — spectral debris scatter, light-mote sparks pinging away, hollow ring decay at the end

assets.name: combo-multiplier-3x
assets.prompt: Combo x3 milestone jingle: a tight three-note ascending triplet with spectral shimmer, upbeat and confirming

assets.name: combo-multiplier-7x
assets.prompt: Combo x7 milestone jingle: a bright fifth interval with a digital glitter burst over it, energetic and proud
